title: A benefit out of reach
literal_meaning: What does the crow gain when the bael fruit ripens?
explanation: A desirable thing can become available without helping someone who cannot make use of it. The saying asks who actually benefits, not merely whether something is good.
meaning_odia: ଭଲ ଜିନିଷ ମିଳିଲେ ବି ତାହାକୁ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି ନ ପାରିଲେ ଲାଭ ମିଳେନାହିଁ। କାହା ପାଇଁ ଜିନିଷଟି ଉପଯୋଗୀ, ସେ କଥା ଏଠାରେ ମୁଖ୍ୟ।
usage_example: A village receives digital equipment but has no reliable electricity to use it. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The source gloss concerns a useful thing failing to reach the appropriate person. The fruit-and-crow image is proverbial, not a biological claim about every crow.
